topics.title: A few OPLET problems
topics.text:
Hey guys, here are a few problems from an OPLET set that I am having difficulties with:



What is the value of the sum $\frac{1}{1*3}+\frac{1}{3*5}+\frac{1}{5*7}+...+\frac{1}{199*201}$? I really feel like there is a nice factorization thing that I am missing here.



Find a 5-digit number for which all of the following are true:

a) The number's square root is a prime palindrome.

b) The number's first two digits express a perfect square.

c) The number's middle digit is a perfect square.

d) The number's last two digits express a perfect square.



Is there any way to do this besides guessing-and-checking, starting from $101^2$? Also, is there an easy way to find the squares of 3 digit prime palindromes?

topics.title: 2016 LMT Theme #7
topics.text:
Let $R(x)$ be a function that takes a natural number as input and returns a rectangle. $R(1)$ is known to have integer side lengths. Let $p(x)$ be the perimeter of $R(x)$ and let $a(x)$ be the area of $R(x)$. Suppose that $p(x+5)=6 p(x)$ for all $x$ in the domain of $R$ and that $a(x+2)=12a(x)$ for all $x> 6$ in the domain of $R$. For $x \leq 6$, $a(x+1)=a(x)+2$. Suppose $p(16)=1296$, and let the side lengths of $R(11)$ be $a$ and $b$ with $a\leq b$. Find the ordered pair $(a,b)$.



Proposed by Matthew Weiss

topics.title: Can Someone Help Me Solve This Problem PLZ
topics.text:
Here is the problem: There is a general leading a 200 yard army. The captain is at the back of the line and sends a runner to deliver a message to the general at the front of the line. The general then sends him back to the captain with another message. When he arrives the captain is in the same place the general was when he first ran to give a message to the general. What is the total distance the runner ran?



If you could, please give me the answer and explain. Thanks!

topics.title: The Rope Problem
topics.text:
Alice, Bob, and Carl are best friends. They decide to make the Triangle of Triangles. Alice and Carl run away from Bob at a 90 degree angle. Alice runs 5 meters, and Carl runs 12 meters. They are all connected by a rope. Bullies Derek and Edith try to mess it up. From Bob, Derek runs at a 30 degree angle until he meets the rope and Edith runs at a 60 degree angle until she meets the rope. Both Derek and Edith have ropes attached to them and Bob. How long is:

i) Derek's rope

ii) Edith's rope?
